name: Kind Fish 73
author: AnthonyPreite
description: Gradient dark light green button that scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes scale(1.1), text color changes from #ffffff to #0f0f0f, opacity becomes 1.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Kind Fish 73</title>
<style>
/* Kind Fish 73 by AnthonyPreite — https://uiverse.io/AnthonyPreite/kind-fish-73 */
.button {
  position: relative;
  height: 50px;
  width: 130px;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  color: white;
  background: #0f0f0f;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-family: 'Gruppo', sans-serif;
  transition: all .2s ease-out;
}

.button:before {
  position: absolute;
  content: '';
  top: -4px;
  left: -4px;
  height: calc(100% + 8px);
  width: calc(100% + 8px);
  border-radius: 6px;
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 1;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, hsla(141, 54%, 86%, 1) 0%, hsla(333, 73%, 85%, 1) 25%, hsla(141, 54%, 86%, 1)50%);
  background-size: 400%;
  transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out;
  animation: animate 20s linear infinite;
}

.button:hover {
  transform: scale(1.1);
  color: #0f0f0f;
  opacity: 1;
  transition: all .3s ease-in-out;
}

.button:active {
  background: none;
  color: #000000;
  transform: scale(1);
  transition: all .3s ease-in-out;
}

@keyframes animate {
  0% {
    background-position: 0 0;
  }

  50% {
    background-position: 400% 0;
  }

  100% {
    background-position: 0 0;
  }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
      I'm a Button
    </button>

</body>
</html>
